_README: Speaker aliases, applied at RENDER time -- never to the dump, never to
grid_rows. The dump is immutable and grid_rows is derived: an UPDATE
there survives exactly until the next grid_index run rebuilds it.
Copy this file to aliases.json and edit. aliases.json is gitignored,
because a real alias table is a list of real people and who you meet
with. Keep yours out of version control.
`confirmed` is APPLIED. `proposed` is NOT -- it is what the data
suggests, held back until a human says so. Promote an entry by moving
it into `confirmed` and re-running the sync.
Matching is case- and whitespace-insensitive on the variant; the
canonical form is written out verbatim.
